name: Ukitsu Kanako
source:
Kanako, is same grade with Yukari and Kana, is a secretary of student council in the first and second grades, and the vice-president in the third grade. She speaks in a slow tone.

She has a younger sister named [url=/c10776]Sayoko[/url], who appears in Otoboku's sequel, Futari no Elder.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Supporting_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
